# Tech Policy Press

> Independent nonprofit media covering the intersection of technology policy, regulation, and democracy across global jurisdictions.

Tech Policy Press provides in-depth analysis of emerging tech regulations, platform accountability, AI governance, and digital rights issues. The site tracks policy developments, regulations, and litigation affecting technology companies and digital platforms worldwide.

## Key Topics

- AI Regulation
- Platform Regulation
- Content Moderation
- Section 230
- Digital Rights
- Election Security
- Consumer Protection
- Algorithmic Accountability
- National Security
- EU AI Act
- Social Media Policy
- Data Privacy
- Tech Sovereignty
- Democratic Governance

## Core Resources

- [Homepage](https://www.techpolicy.press): Main entry point for Tech Policy Press nonprofit media venture on technology and democracy
- [Policy Tracker](https://www.techpolicy.press/tracker): Comprehensive database tracking tech regulations, investigations, and litigation globally
- [About Us](https://www.techpolicy.press/about-us): Mission statement, team information, and editorial independence principles
- [Newsletter](https://www.techpolicy.press/newsletter): Subscribe to regular updates and analysis on technology policy developments

## AI Governance & Regulation

- [How Cal State Became Ground Zero for the Fight over AI in Higher Education](https://www.techpolicy.press/how-cal-state-became-ground-zero-for-the-fight-over-ai-in-higher-education): Analysis of Cal State's OpenAI ChatGPT integration deal and faculty backlash
- [Europe Is Looking To Water Down AI Protections. It Should Reinforce Them.](https://www.techpolicy.press/europe-is-looking-to-water-down-ai-protections-it-should-reinforce-them): Critique of EU AI Act weakening in trilogue negotiations on consumer protections
- [The High Stakes of Pakistan's Push for AI Sovereignty](https://www.techpolicy.press/the-high-stakes-of-pakistans-push-for-ai-sovereignty): Pakistan's AI sovereignty strategy and geopolitical autonomy through tech infrastructure
- [When Conversations with AI Become Evidence](https://www.techpolicy.press/when-conversations-with-ai-become-evidence): Legal analysis of AI chat histories as courtroom evidence and admissibility questions
- [How AI Content Detection is Being Weaponized in the Iran War](https://www.techpolicy.press/how-ai-content-detection-is-being-weaponized-in-the-iran-war): AI content detection misuse in Iran-Israel conflict undermining evidence accountability

## Platform Accountability & Content Moderation

- [Why Better Platform Data Won't Show Regulators What They Need to See](https://www.techpolicy.press/why-better-platform-data-wont-show-regulators-what-they-need-to-see): Critique of Digital Services Act researcher data access limitations for platform auditing
- [How States Are Taking on Algorithmic Pricing](https://www.techpolicy.press/how-states-are-taking-on-algorithmic-pricing): State regulatory responses to algorithmic pricing and surveillance pricing in housing
- [Social Media Fuels Community Violence. Prevention Needs an Upgrade.](https://www.techpolicy.press/social-media-fuels-community-violence-prevention-needs-an-upgrade): Social media's role in accelerating gang violence and community conflict escalation
- [Policymakers Ignore Spyware Middlemen Driving Global Proliferation](https://www.techpolicy.press/policymakers-ignore-spyware-middlemen-driving-global-proliferation): Atlantic Council report on spyware intermediaries and global supply chain proliferation

## Election Security & Democratic Governance

- [Brazil Is Preparing for Its First Real AI Election, But Is It Ready?](https://www.techpolicy.press/brazil-is-preparing-for-its-first-real-ai-election-but-is-it-ready): Brazil's election court prepares to police AI in 2026 elections amid regulation challenges
- [Ecuador Makes a National Security Case for Teen Social Media Restrictions](https://www.techpolicy.press/ecuador-makes-a-national-security-case-for-teen-social-media-restrictions): Ecuador's national security approach to teen social media bans amid crime crisis

## Child Protection & Digital Rights

- [Brazil Wants to Reshape The Internet for Kids. The Hard Part Just Began.](https://www.techpolicy.press/brazil-wants-to-reshape-the-internet-for-kids-the-hard-part-just-began): Brazil's child protection law enforcement challenges and age verification implementation
